rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for someone's disposition or an unpleasant, rude manner.

example.english: The way you talk to people shows a really bad attitude.
example.traditional: 你咁樣同人哋講嘢，態度好差喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 tung4 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 taai3 dou6 hou2 caa1 wo3

rows.note: Use this for the physical position or way someone carries their body, not their state of mind.

example.english: His attitude on stage—his physical bearing—is really impressive.
example.traditional: 佢企喺台上面個姿勢好有台型。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kei5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 min6 go3 zi1 sai3 hou2 jau5 toi4 jing4
